outcome: An artifact card can be cast from hand only in a main phase of its controller's turn with an empty stack.
A resolving artifact spell moves to the battlefield under its controller's control.
An attempt to attach an Equipment to a non-creature leaves the Equipment where it is.
An Equipment enters the battlefield unattached; an effect attaching it to an object it cannot equip leaves it unmoved.
An Equipment attached to an illegal or nonexistent permanent becomes unattached in the state-based check and stays on the battlefield.
Changing control of an Equipment or its creature does not change the other's controller, and only the Equipment's controller can activate its abilities.
An Equipment put onto the battlefield attached to an object it cannot legally equip enters unattached.
A Fortification attaches only to lands; the Equipment attachment outcomes apply to it with lands.
A Vehicle has power and toughness only while it is a creature.
A Vehicle that becomes a creature immediately has its printed power and toughness, modified by applicable effects.
